name: Soul Exchange
extDescription: Select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field. This turn, if your Tribute a monster on your side of the field, Tribute the selected monster instead. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase during the turn you activate this card.

extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Fortress Whale". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 7 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Skilled Dark Magician
extDescription: Each time you or your opponent activates 1 Spell Card, put 1 Spell Counter on this card (max. 3). Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it to Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: Skilled White Magician
extDescription: Each time you or your opponent activates 1 Spell Card, put 1 Spell Counter on this card (max. 3). Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it to Special Summon 1 "Buster Blader" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: Wall of Illusion
extDescription: A monster that attacks this monster is returned to its owners hand after damage calculation. Damage calculation is applied normally.

name: Last Will
extDescription: If a monster on your side of the field was sent to your Graveyard this turn, your can Special Summon 1 monster with the ATK of 1500 or less from your Deck once during this turn. Then shuffle the Deck.
